description: Add IOS configuration commands to a router, switch or multilayer switch (not PCs, servers, ASAs, access points or wireless routers). Commands run in GLOBAL CONFIGURATION MODE: do not send `enable`, `configure terminal`, `end` or `write memory` (PTBuilder saves automatically); such lines are dropped and reported. Leave sub-modes (interface, router ospf, line) with `exit`. Use full interface names (interface GigabitEthernet0/0). Commands are appended to earlier ones; set replace: true to overwrite the device's previous commands. Invalid commands fail silently in PT.

ios_commands.description: IOS commands in global configuration mode, one per item, e.g. ["hostname R1", "interface GigabitEthernet0/0", "ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0", "no shutdown", "exit"]. At most 2000 items of 512 characters; a device keeps at most 2000 commands.

name.description: Device name, e.g. R1, S1, PC1 (case-insensitive).

replace.description: true = discard this device's previous commands first.

name: configure_device
title: Configure IOS device
